frontmatter.title: PQueue
frontmatter.description_template: API reference for the PQueue class in p-queue v{version}.

constructor.summary: Creates a queue instance that controls how many tasks start at the same time and across an interval.

queue_options.name: concurrency
queue_options.summary: Limits how many tasks run at the same time.

queue_options.name: timeout
queue_options.summary: Applies a per-task timeout in milliseconds.

queue_options.name: throwOnTimeout
queue_options.summary: Controls whether a timeout rejects instead of resolving with no value.

queue_options.name: autoStart
queue_options.summary: Starts queued work as soon as capacity is available.

queue_options.name: queueClass
queue_options.summary: Supplies a queue implementation with enqueue, dequeue, and size support.

queue_options.name: intervalCap
queue_options.summary: Limits how many runs can start during one interval window.

queue_options.name: interval
queue_options.summary: Defines the interval window in milliseconds.

queue_options.name: carryoverConcurrencyCount
queue_options.summary: Counts pending tasks against the next interval window when enabled.

task_options.name: priority
task_options.summary: Higher values are scheduled before lower values.

task_options.name: id
task_options.summary: Identifies a queued task so its priority can be updated before execution.

task_options.name: signal
task_options.summary: Cancels a queued task or notifies a running task about cancellation.

task_options.name: timeout
task_options.summary: Overrides the queue-level timeout for one task.

task_options.name: throwOnTimeout
task_options.summary: Overrides timeout rejection behavior for one task.

methods.name: add(fn, options?)
summary_markers: Adds a sync or async task.
Always returns a promise.
The task receives `{signal}` as the first argument when it runs.

methods.name: addAll(functions, options?)
summary_markers: Accepts an array of sync or async functions.
Resolves when all queued functions settle.

methods.name: start()
summary_markers: Starts or resumes queued work.
Returns the queue instance.

methods.name: pause()
summary_markers: Puts queue execution on hold.

methods.name: clear()
summary_markers: Clears queued work that has not started yet.

methods.name: onEmpty()
summary_markers: Settles when the queue becomes empty.

methods.name: onIdle()
summary_markers: Settles when the queue is empty and no tasks are still pending.

methods.name: onSizeLessThan(limit)
summary_markers: Waits until `queue.size < limit`.
Counts queued tasks waiting to start.

methods.name: sizeBy(options)
summary_markers: Returns the queue size filtered by matching options.
Can be used to inspect queued work for one priority level.

methods.name: setPriority(id, priority)
summary_markers: Updates the priority of a queued task by id.
A defined concurrency limit is required for this to affect execution order.

properties.name: concurrency
summary_markers: Gets or sets the concurrency limit.
Values below 1 throw a TypeError.

properties.name: timeout
summary_markers: Stores the default timeout in milliseconds for future tasks.

properties.name: size
summary_markers: Counts queued items waiting to run.

properties.name: pending
summary_markers: Counts running items that are no longer in the queue.

properties.name: isPaused
summary_markers: Reports whether the queue is currently paused.

events.name: active
summary_markers: Fires when a task starts running.

events.name: completed
summary_markers: Fires when a task resolves successfully.

events.name: error
summary_markers: Fires when a task rejects or throws.

events.name: empty
summary_markers: Fires when the queue becomes empty.

events.name: idle
summary_markers: Fires when all running work has completed.

events.name: add
summary_markers: Fires when work is added to the queue.

events.name: next
summary_markers: Fires when the queue moves to the next slot.

behavior_notes.text: Greater `priority` values schedule before lower values while work is still queued.
Queue-level `timeout` can be overridden per `add()` call.
`onEmpty()` only tracks queued items, while `onIdle()` also waits for running tasks.
`carryoverConcurrencyCount` controls whether pending work counts against the next `intervalCap` window.

intro.opening_sentence: `PQueue` creates a promise queue with concurrency control, rate-limiting async or sync operations, timeout handling, and queued reprioritization.
